question: Should ClawHub consume `@openclaw/design-system` through a public install path, or should maintainers explicitly operate a private cross-repository credential for hosted CI and Vercel?
rationale: The code change is straightforward, but the safe merge path depends on package distribution and credential ownership decisions that automation should not choose.

options.title: Resolve Package Access Before Merge
options.body: Keep this PR draft until the design-system package is public or hosted installs use a narrow approved credential, then require green CI and Vercel.

options.title: Accept Private Credential Ownership
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers intentionally own the private dependency and document the CI, Vercel, deploy, and Dependabot credential path.

options.title: Pause The Design-System Stack
options.body: Leave this and the stacked palette PR open or paused until the design-system package distribution policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Resolve Package Access Before Merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR draft until the design-system package is public or hosted installs use a narrow approved credential, then require green CI and Vercel.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick owns the recent package, vendored-skill, and preview/deploy history touched by this stack.
